basic_details.job_title: OIL Domain Expert Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Oil India Limited (OIL), a Maharatna Public Sector Undertaking, will empanel one retired officer as Domain Expert (Critical Minerals) on an on-call, contract basis for 02 (Two) years under its Critical Mineral Exploration Programme, at an honorarium of ₹10,000/- to ₹20,000/- per day depending on level/grade. Candidates need an M.Sc./M. Tech. in Geology / Applied Geology and at least 25 years of relevant experience, and must send the prescribed application by post or to [email protected] on or before 23:59 hours of 5 December 2026.

age_limit.details: The candidate should not be more than 68 years of age as on 05/12/2026. The candidate must also have a minimum of 02 remaining years before attaining the maximum permissible age limit of 70 years at the time of application. | Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

how_to_apply: Fill in the application only in the prescribed format, "Application for Empanelment as Domain Expert (Critical Minerals)", attached to the notice.

Affix a recent passport size photograph and give personal details, educational qualifications, membership of professional bodies and experience details, with a write-up on relevant experience of maximum 300 words.
Sign the declaration with date and place.
Enclose self-attested copies of proof of date of birth and proof of relevant experience/educational qualification.
Send the application to Chief General Manager (HR-Acquisitions), OIL Human Resources Office, Oil India Limited, 3rd Floor, P.O. Duliajan, Assam-786602, or by email to [email protected].
Make sure it is sent on or before 23:59 hours of 05/12/2026.
Recent passport size photograph (affixed on the form)
important_instructions: Online application received after 23:59 hours of 05/12/2026 will be rejected. Applications submitted without supporting documents for proof of date of birth, educational qualification and relevant experience will also be rejected. If the information provided is found incorrect or false, the empanelment may be cancelled at any time without informing the candidate.

rows.details: OIL's Critical Mineral Exploration Programme (Phop, Jorkian and other critical mineral blocks)

By post to the Duliajan address or by email to [email protected]

content_sections.heading: About OIL Domain Expert (Critical Minerals)
content_sections.text: Oil India Limited describes itself in the notice as a Maharatna Public Sector Undertaking and the second largest national upstream Oil & Gas Company with a pan India presence and global footprint. In line with the Government of India's National Critical Mineral Mission (NCMM), OIL has diversified into exploration and development of critical and strategic minerals and has secured two strategic critical mineral blocks under the Composite Licence (CL) regime: Phop Block in Arunachal Pradesh and Jorkian Block in Rajasthan. The Domain Expert is being empanelled for specialised assignments under this programme.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Applications are invited only from retired officers . The essential requirements for the Domain Expert (Critical Minerals) post are: Masters in M.Sc./M. Tech. in Geology / Applied Geology from Government recognized College/ Universities/ Institution. Retired from a Government mining/geoscientific organization in the pay scale of at least ₹1,82,200– ₹2,24,100. A minimum of 25 years of relevant professional experience. Candidates who have worked with the Geological Survey of India and have at least one year of experience in Critical Mineral Assessment would be preferred. Good interpersonal, delegation, liaison, networking and communication skills to establish effective relationships internal and external to the organization. Experience in technical planning of an Exploration project for deep-seated and critical minerals. Preparation of Prospecting & Exploration plan for the composite and mining lease blocks, including Geological, Geophysical and Geochemical techniques. Estimation and evaluation of resource/reserve of bedded, deep-seated and critical minerals as per the United Nations Framework Classification for Resources (UNFC), with follow-up of The Minerals (Evidence of Mineral Contents) MEMC Rules 2015 and The Australasian Joint Ore Reserves Committee (JORC) Rules. Ability to provide expert advice for searching deep-seated minerals in uncovered areas. Experience in selecting and exploring lithium, cobalt, graphite, nickel, copper, potash, REE and other associated critical minerals. Experience and knowledge of various facets of work related to Geology & Mining, Policy & Regulation of Mines and Minerals. Good understanding of mining leases and familiarity with government procedures and policies. Ability to prepare technical components of RFPs for the engagement of consultants for critical mineral exploration. The candidate should not be more than 68 years of age as on 05/12/2026. The candidate must also have a minimum of 02 remaining years before attaining the maximum permissible age limit of 70 years at the time of application. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The Domain Expert on call duty is paid a per-day honorarium according to level/grade: Travel, local conveyance, boarding and lodging will be arranged by OIL as per the entitlements of regular executives of their status in OIL. No other facilities will be extended or borne by OIL. The period of empanelment is 02 (Two) years, and the selected candidate shall be engaged on a contract basis. The engagement will be on-call basis from time to time during the project period. Domain experts will be engaged up to 100 days during the year, starting from the date of the empanelment. A non-binding understanding between the Project Proponent and the Domain Expert on the Project Plan will be the basis of engagement. The empanelment is terminable at any time by serving 01 (One) month notice in writing by either party. The expert will report at CoEES, OIL, Guwahati, and may be required to visit areas in and outside India occasionally for business development and as per operational requirements.

content_sections.heading: OIL Domain Expert (Critical Minerals) Job Description
content_sections.text: The Domain Expert shall provide technical guidance for ongoing and upcoming activities associated with the exploration and development of the Phop, Jorkian and other critical mineral blocks, including: Geological mapping Trenching and drilling Core studies and laboratory data interpretation Hydrogeological investigations Beneficiation studies Resource estimation and other associated activities

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for OIL Domain Expert (Critical Minerals)
content_sections.text: Fill in the application only in the prescribed format, "Application for Empanelment as Domain Expert (Critical Minerals)", attached to the notice. Affix a recent passport size photograph and give personal details, educational qualifications, membership of professional bodies and experience details, with a write-up on relevant experience of maximum 300 words. Sign the declaration with date and place. Enclose self-attested copies of proof of date of birth and proof of relevant experience/educational qualification. Send the application to Chief General Manager (HR-Acquisitions), OIL Human Resources Office, Oil India Limited, 3rd Floor, P.O. Duliajan, Assam-786602, or by email to [email protected] . Make sure it is sent on or before 23:59 hours of 05/12/2026. Recent passport size photograph (affixed on the form) Proof of Date of Birth Proof of relevant experience/Education Qualification

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Online application received after 23:59 hours of 05/12/2026 will be rejected. Applications submitted without supporting documents for proof of date of birth, educational qualification and relevant experience will also be rejected. If the information provided is found incorrect or false, the empanelment may be cancelled at any time without informing the candidate.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in OIL Recruitment 2026 for Domain Expert?
faq.answer: There is 01 post of Domain Expert (Critical Minerals) under Advertisement No. HRAQ/CONT-EX-B/26-315.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the OIL Domain Expert post?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent on or before 23:59 hours of 5 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for OIL Domain Expert (Critical Minerals)?
faq.answer: An M.Sc./M. Tech. in Geology / Applied Geology from a Government recognized institution, retirement from a Government mining/geoscientific organization in the pay scale of at least ₹1,82,200–₹2,24,100, and at least 25 years of relevant experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the OIL Domain Expert post?
faq.answer: The candidate should not be more than 68 years of age as on 05/12/2026 and must have at least 02 remaining years before reaching the maximum permissible age of 70 years at the time of application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the honorarium for OIL Domain Expert?
faq.answer: The honorarium is ₹20,000/- per day for CMD/MD/Directors, ₹15,000/- per day for EDs/CGM/GGM/GMs/Professor or equivalent, and ₹10,000/- per day for DGMs/Associate Professor or equivalent.

faq.question: Q6. How to apply for the OIL Domain Expert post?
faq.answer: Send the prescribed application with self-attested documents to Chief General Manager (HR-Acquisitions), OIL Human Resources Office, Oil India Limited, 3rd Floor, P.O. Duliajan, Assam-786602, or by email to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. Is the OIL Domain Expert job permanent?
faq.answer: No. It is an empanelment on contract, on-call basis, for 02 (Two) years, terminable by 01 (One) month notice in writing by either party.

faq.question: Q8. How many days a year will the Domain Expert be engaged?
faq.answer: Domain experts will be engaged up to 100 days during the year, starting from the date of the empanelment.

faq.question: Q9. Who gets preference for the OIL Domain Expert post?
faq.answer: Candidates who have worked with the Geological Survey of India and have at least one year of experience in Critical Mineral Assessment would be preferred.

faq.question: Q10. Will OIL pay for travel and stay?
faq.answer: Yes. Travel, local conveyance, boarding and lodging will be arranged by OIL as per the entitlements of regular executives of their status in OIL; no other facilities will be extended.
